description: Search and read the shared server Wiki, a company-wide Markdown knowledge base; app administrators can also create, edit, publish, restore and delete its articles.
migration_note: Compiled Rust adapter storing articles and revisions in the application plane. Reads are open to permitted sessions (visitors see published articles only); writes are limited to app administrators in code. Keyword search, widened by caller-supplied synonyms and per-article keywords (no embeddings); automatic recall, a Wiki page and external (GitHub) wikis are not ported yet. Deployment requires rebuilding both API and loop.
skill_summary: Search, read and cite the shared server Wiki; app administrators can maintain its articles with revision history.
